genxml.title: GIGAchannel cabinet system-controller status word, as IRIX and the BASEIO PROM read it
genxml.from: shipped IRIX kernel and BASEIO PROM images, read by disassembly: software expectation
genxml.doc: The 16-bit status word that the GIGAchannel expansion cabinet presents to the node it hangs off, read by the IRIX kernel and by the BASEIO PROM. The word sits in the widget-8 window of the Crossbow in that cabinet. Nothing in the held images writes it, so the bit meanings below are the software's reading only. Every item is inferred. The reset value is unknown.

struct.name: STATUS
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel and BASEIO PROM images, read by disassembly: software expectation
struct.doc: Cabinet status word, read at STATUS_OFFSET within the widget-8 window of the node's Hub. Software only reads it. No software writes it in the images read, and what a write would do is unknown. Bits 7 to 15 have no meaning that software reads. After start-up the IRIX kernel examines only bits 0 to 5, and bit 6 only once, at start-up.

struct.name: XBOW_ID
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel and BASEIO PROM images, read by disassembly: software expectation
struct.doc: Identification word of the Crossbow, read through each node's Hub at the widget-0 offset below. The kernel reads it at start-up to decide whether the node has a cabinet.
